concepts.learning_objective: Define total and marginal utility and compute one from the other.
Explain the law of diminishing marginal utility and how it explains a downward sloping demand curve.

topics.title: Ordinal Utility Analysis and Indifference Curves

concepts.learning_objective: Define and calculate the marginal rate of substitution and state the law of diminishing MRS.
Explain the shape and features of indifference curves and the indifference map.
Apply the idea of monotonic preferences to rank consumption bundles.
Describe the budget set and budget line, their intercepts and slope.
Analyse how changes in income and prices change the budget line.
Locate the consumer's optimum bundle as the tangency of the budget line with an indifference curve.
Explain why MRS must equal the price ratio at the optimum and how a consumer adjusts when it does not.

topics.title: Demand, Law of Demand and Types of Goods

concepts.learning_objective: State the law of demand and interpret the demand function and a linear demand curve.
Distinguish normal, inferior and Giffen goods using income and substitution effects.
Distinguish substitutes from complements by the effect of a related good's price.

topics.title: Shifts in Demand and Market Demand

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish a movement along the demand curve from a shift of the demand curve.
Derive market demand by horizontal summation of individual demand curves.

topics.title: Price Elasticity of Demand and its Measurement

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate price elasticity of demand by the percentage method and classify it.
Analyse how elasticity varies along a linear demand curve and identify constant elasticity curves.

topics.title: Determinants of Elasticity, and Elasticity and Expenditure

concepts.learning_objective: Identify how necessities, luxuries and close substitutes affect price elasticity.
Predict the change in expenditure on a good from its price elasticity.
